einzeiler: A retrospective look back through episodes 500 to 599 of the podcast
kurzfassung: This episode celebrates passing the 700-episode milestone with a meandering retrospective look back at episodes 500 through 599. The host reflects on various creative series, on-location recordings, and fan interactions from previous years. Along the way, he offers his trademark soothing tangents and gentle bedtime company to help listeners drift off.
stichpunkte: Reflecting on the milestone of reaching 700 episodes of the podcast
Reviewing memorable episodes and creative arcs from the 500s range
Discussing special series like Superdoll, Big Farm PI, and After the Glass Slipper
Highlighting various Star Trek The Next Generation recap episodes
Recalling unique on-location recordings from places like Orlando and Lake Ontario
Expressing deep gratitude to listeners for their ongoing support and word-of-mouth promotion
Promoting a special holiday discount for the Sleep With Me Plus subscription tiers

clips.text: The host humorously imagines his brain packing a suitcase and questions whether narrative devices possess sentience and emotions.
The speaker mentions receiving episode suggestions for a classic Star Trek review from the creator of another popular audio show.

clips.hook: The sweet spot for episode length
clips.text: The host notes that most installments run for roughly an hour, which he considers the ideal duration for his audio material.

clips.hook: The tale of Persephone in disguise
clips.text: A listener recently pointed out that a clamshell-themed royal story was actually a covert retelling of a famous mythological descent.
The podcaster outlines the specifics of a seasonal discount available for dedicated superfans during the holiday push.
